business_problem: Karls Erlebnis-Dorf needed to reduce administrative bottlenecks caused by manual processes and spreadsheet-driven analysis so it could scale family entertainment, food production, and new-site planning without losing focus on guest experience.
solution_summary: Karls Erlebnis-Dorf rolled out Gemini Enterprise and Google Workspace as an internal productivity and search layer across its growing agritourism business. The company first deployed Gemini Enterprise to 80 employees so marketing, administrative, and project teams could draft festival campaigns, summarize long documents, research regional regulations, and search across internal records from email, calendars, and Google Drive without manual digging. Instead of relying on disconnected spreadsheets, staff now use automated document analysis and grounded search over company data to find project history, construction details, and operational context in seconds. This knowledge layer reduces repetitive work while keeping employees in familiar Google tools, and it gives the company a base for more advanced data analysis and future custom IT solutions built with Antigravity. The net effect is a faster decision cycle that frees staff to spend more time improving the in-person guest experience.

solution_components.name: Gemini Enterprise
solution_components.role: Automates routine internal tasks and searches grounded in Karls' own data and records.

solution_components.name: Google Workspace
solution_components.role: Provides the email, calendar, drive, and collaboration data that Gemini searches and summarizes.

solution_components.name: Antigravity

data_flow: Employee documents, emails, calendars, and drive files inside Google Workspace are queried through Gemini Enterprise so staff can retrieve project history, generate content, and analyze internal information without manually consolidating spreadsheets and documents.
business_outcome: Karls saves employees between 40 minutes and two hours on routine tasks, replaces manual spreadsheet work with automated analysis, and uses grounded search to speed decisions while keeping teams focused on guest-facing innovation.
